LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Old Belief and Promise
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Old Belief and Promise (T-09-97) hangs by three cords as a glowing orb clasped by twin blue and gold puzzle serpents.\nOaths sworn before it permanently empower the wielder's primary weapon up to +40% damage—at an escalating risk of shattering betrayal.
